description: Create DashboardCalendar component showing PG-wide events (payments, check-ins, check-outs, rent dues, notices) with Grid/Heatmap/Agenda views, interactive filtering, and add it to the dashboard page
steps: 1. Create lib/services/dashboard-calendar.ts server action file

2. In dashboard-calendar.ts, import ALL models at top (Room, Bed, Resident, RentRecord, Payment, ElectricityBill, Deposit, PlanHistory, Settings) with 'void Model;' pattern after imports to prevent MissingSchemaError per context.json pattern

3. Implement 'export async function getDashboardCalendarData(month: string)' that takes month param (format YYYY-MM), calls connectDB(), and queries: (a) paymentsData: Payment.find for given month grouped by date with count and total amount per date; (b) rentDueData: RentRecord.find with dueDate in month, populate resident name, group by date; (c) checkoutsData: Resident.find with expectedLeavingDate or leavingDate in month, populate room; (d) checkinsData: Resident.find with joiningDate in month; (e) noticesData: Resident.find with noticeDate in month; (f) depositRefundsData: Deposit.find with refundDate in month OR residents with status='left' and deposit held; (g) todaySummary: aggregate counts and amounts for today; (h) heatmapData: calculate activity score per date using formula (payment_count * 10) + (checkout_count * 15) + (checkin_count * 15) + (rentdue_count * 8)
4. Return all data as plain serializable object (convert all Mongoose documents with .lean() and map to plain arrays with date strings in ISO format)
5. Add TypeScript interface exports for DashboardCalendarData, PaymentDayData, RentDueDayData, CheckoutDayData, CheckinDayData, NoticeDayData, TodaySummary, HeatmapDayData
6. Create components/dashboard/DashboardCalendar.tsx as 'use client' component

7. In DashboardCalendar.tsx, import useState/useMemo, shadcn Card/Badge/Button/Sheet, lucide-react icons (Calendar, TrendingUp, Users, DoorOpen, Receipt, Zap, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight), and the dashboard-calendar types
8. Define component props interface: { initialData: DashboardCalendarData, initialMonth: string }

9. Implement top stats bar: render 4 animated stat chips showing todaySummary data (Payments Expected, Check-ins, Check-outs, Rent Dues) with icon, count, amount where relevant, each chip clickable to filter events
10. Implement view mode toggle: 3 buttons (Grid | Heatmap | Agenda) using useState, default 'grid', styled as segmented control with rounded-xl and active state bg-[#007AFF] text-white

11. Implement filter chips: multi-select badges for [All] [Payments] [Check-ins] [Check-outs] [Notices] [Electricity] using useState array, clicking toggles filter, filtered events update calendar rendering

12. Implement Grid view: same compact calendar structure as ResidentCalendar (7-column grid, day headers, date cells p-1.5 text-sm), render colored dots per event type (max 4 visible), aggregate all resident events per date, hover shows tooltip with counts and amounts, same glassmorphism styling

13. Implement Heatmap view: same grid structure but cells colored by activity score from heatmapData using gradient scale (score 0='#F2F2F7', 1-20='#BFD9FF', 21-50='#7FBFFF', 51-100='#007AFF', 100+='#0055CC'), no event dots in this mode, show score on hover

14. Implement Agenda view: replace grid with vertical list of next 14 days from today, each day as a card showing all events for that day grouped by type with icon/count/amount, sorted by date ascending, use same color coding as grid dots

15. Implement month navigation: prev/next buttons at top, onChange call a transition to fetch new month data (use useTransition and a fetch to '/api/dashboard-calendar?month=YYYY-MM' OR implement as a server action call with startTransition)

16. Implement date click handler: onClick opens Sheet (side='bottom' on mobile, side='right' on desktop) showing all events for clicked date with full details (resident names, amounts, links to /residents/[id])
17. Add mobile responsiveness: ensure calendar works on 320px viewports, stats bar wraps to 2x2 grid on mobile, view toggle buttons stack or scroll horizontally

18. Create API route app/api/dashboard-calendar/route.ts (if using fetch approach) that calls getDashboardCalendarData and returns JSON, OR implement client-side server action import if using that pattern

19. Open app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx and import DashboardCalendar component with dynamic import: const DashboardCalendar = dynamic(() => import('@/components/dashboard/DashboardCalendar'), { ssr: false })
20. In dashboard page's Promise.all, add getDashboardCalendarData(currentMonth) call where currentMonth is computed from new Date()
21. Add <DashboardCalendar initialData={calendarData} initialMonth={currentMonth} /> component between the header section and stat cards section (before statCards.map)
22. Test all views: Grid shows event dots, Heatmap shows color gradient, Agenda shows list, filters work, month navigation updates data, date click opens details sheet
